title: A coherent depth-two module extending a finite etale algebra
statement:
theorem exists_depth_two_coherent_module_extension
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y) (L.presheaf.stalk y))
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite f] [Etale f] :
    let g := f ≫ U.ι
    let B : L.CommAlgebraSheaf := Under.mk
      (⟨g.c⟩ : L.sheaf ⟶ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} g.base).obj X.sheaf)
    ∃ N : L.Modules,
      N.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      (∀ V : L.Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
        Module.Finite (L.presheaf.obj (op V)) (N.val.obj (op V))) ∧
      (∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
        ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite (L.presheaf.stalk y)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y),
          letI := hfinite
          (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y)) ∧
      Nonempty (Modules.restrict N U.ι ≅ Modules.restrict B.toModule U.ι)

proof.text: Apply [lem-sbc-affine-depth-two-pushforward-hull] on every affine chart. Take N to be the already constructed actual pushforward B.toModule. The source-library affine presentation criterion in QuasicoherentKernel turns the quasi-coherent restrictions into global quasi-coherence. Its finite_sections_of_finite_sections_restrict_fromSpec transports finite global chart sections to finite sections on every affine open.

For a boundary point y choose an affine chart V and x in Spec Gamma(L,V) mapping to y. The open-immersion stalk isomorphism compares the restricted module stalk with N_y. Its scalar compatibility is proved on germs in restrict_stalk_smul, using appIso_inv_app and germ_smul. Package it as a semilinear bijection to transfer Module.Finite. The proved depth_le_of_semilinear_equiv maps regular sequences and the maximal ideal along the ring equivalence, preserving lengths; Nakayama handles nonzero finite modules and a zero module has infinite depth. Thus the local boundary bound gives the required bound at y. The restriction isomorphism is Iso.refl since N is B.toModule.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EY6, affine reduction and local nature of coherence/depth; canonical pushforward avoids explicit overlap gluing
